name: Tick Assist (Click Auto-Correct)
description: Mobile & desktop 240 TPS click auto-corrector that delays early clicks (1-16 ticks) using a 480-tick survival lookahead solver.

core-header.name: Core Auto-Correct Engine
core-header.description: Main controls for the 240 TPS click lookahead & early-click auto-corrector.

enabled.name: Enable Click Auto-Correct
enabled.description: Automatically intercepts early clicks and delays them to the earliest safe tick that passes upcoming obstacles.

max-early-ticks.name: Early Click Window (Ticks)
max-early-ticks.description: Maximum number of ticks (1 to 16 at 240 TPS) your click can be early and still get auto-corrected to a passing tick.

lookahead-ticks.name: Lookahead Check Horizon (Ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How many physics ticks ahead (on 240 TPS) the simulator checks to verify you survive and pass the click check (480 ticks = 2.0 seconds at 240 TPS).

base-tps.name: Simulation Tick Rate (TPS)
base-tps.description: Physics tick rate used by the lookahead solver and sub-tick delay queue (standard is 240 TPS).

targets-header.name: What to Auto-Correct From
targets-header.description: Choose which obstacle types, gamemodes, and mechanics the solver checks and auto-corrects.

correct-ground-jumps.name: Ground Spikes & Ledge Jumps
correct-ground-jumps.description: Auto-corrects early ground jumps (Cube, Robot, Ball, Spider) when clicking 1-16 ticks before landing or before clearing a spike gap.

correct-orbs.name: Jump Orbs, Dash Rings & Portals
correct-orbs.description: Auto-corrects clicks that are 1-16 ticks early before entering an orb/ring hitbox or where an immediate orb click hits a hazard.

correct-air-modes.name: Ship, Wave, UFO & Swing Corridors
correct-air-modes.description: Delays early inputs in flying/air modes if pressing immediately would clip a ceiling/floor spike or saw within the lookahead window.

correct-releases.name: Auto-Correct Early Releases
correct-releases.description: Also checks button releases (Ship, Wave, Robot jump hold, Dash orbs) and delays releasing by 1-16 ticks if releasing too early causes death.

preserve-hold-length.name: Preserve Hold Duration After Delay
preserve-hold-length.description: When a press is delayed by N ticks, extends the corresponding release by N ticks so short micro-clicks are never eaten.

correct-player2.name: Dual Mode / Player 2 Support
correct-player2.description: Applies the 240 TPS lookahead auto-corrector to Player 2 clicks in dual mode.

corner-rescue.name: Last-Tick Corner Death Rescue
corner-rescue.description: If a hazard collision happens while a valid passing tick is queued within the 1-16 tick window, executes the queued jump immediately to save the attempt.

ui-header.name: Mobile UI & HUD Overlay
ui-header.description: Configure the in-game mobile quick-settings button and live correction HUD.

show-mobile-button.name: Show In-Game Mobile UI Button
show-mobile-button.description: Adds a compact semi-transparent 'TA' button at the top of the screen during gameplay and in the Pause Menu to open the Tick Assist UI anytime.

show-hud.name: Show Live Tick Correction HUD
show-hud.description: Displays a small status label showing when a click was auto-corrected (e.g. 'Corrected +4t | Safe 480t').
